theorem collisionGame_eq (A : NUPPT) (n : ℕ) : H.collisionGame A n = (ProbComp.sample (H.gen.Coins n)).bind (fun rg => (ProbComp.sample (A.Coins n)).bind fun r => let i := H.gen.runAt n [] rg let xx := splitBits (padFin (H.domLen.eval n + H.domLen.eval n) (A.runAt n i r)) .pure (decide (H.inDom n i xx.1 = true ∧ H.inDom n i xx.2 = true ∧ xx.1 ≠ xx.2 ∧ H.hash n i xx.1 = H.hash n i xx.2)))

theorem compresses_iff : H.Compresses ↔ ∃ n₀ : ℕ, ∀ n, n₀ ≤ n → ∀ rg : H.gen.Coins n, (∀ x, H.inDom n (H.gen.runAt n [] rg) x = true → H.inRange n (H.gen.runAt n [] rg) (H.hash n (H.gen.runAt n [] rg) x) = true) ∧ Fintype.card {y // H.inRange n (H.gen.runAt n [] rg) y = true} < Fintype.card {x // H.inDom n (H.gen.runAt n [] rg) x = true}

theorem predictAdv_eq (C : I → X → Bool) (m : ℕ) (L : (Fin m → X × Bool) → ρ → X → Bool) : predictAdv C m L = |predictSuccess C m L - 1 / 2|
noncomputable def predictSuccess (C : I → X → Bool) (m : ℕ) (L : (Fin m → X × Bool) → ρ → X → Bool) : ℝ
theorem predictSuccess_coin (C : I → X → Bool) (m : ℕ) : predictSuccess C m (fun (_ : Fin m → X × Bool) (r : Bool) (_ : X) => r) = 1 / 2

theorem predictSuccess_eq (C : I → X → Bool) (m : ℕ) (L : (Fin m → X × Bool) → ρ → X → Bool) : predictSuccess C m L = ((trialDist X I ρ m).prod (FinDist.uniform X)).probTrue (fun w => L (label (C w.1.1) w.1.2.1) w.1.2.2 w.2 == C w.1.1 w.2)
theorem predictSuccess_eq_one_sub_expectedErr (C : I → X → Bool) (m : ℕ) (L : (Fin m → X × Bool) → ρ → X → Bool) : predictSuccess C m L = 1 - expectedErr C m L

theorem sub_le_predictAdv_of_weakLearnsUnder {C : I → X → Bool} {m : ℕ} {L : (Fin m → X × Bool) → ρ → X → Bool} {γ δ : ℝ} (h : WeakLearnsUnder (FinDist.uniform X) C m L γ δ) (hγ : γ ≤ 1 / 2) : γ - δ ≤ predictAdv C m L
noncomputable def trialDist (m : ℕ) : FinDist (I × ((Fin m → X) × ρ))
theorem trialDist_eq (m : ℕ) : trialDist X I ρ m = (FinDist.uniform I).prod (((FinDist.uniform X).iid m).prod (FinDist.uniform ρ))
